sessionGoals: Compile Minecraft client/server core, content, and util feature lists; persist in docs and JSON for data-driven use.
Improve terrain generation algorithms for caves, rivers, and lakes; apply to world map control on server and client.
Review protobuf-generated packets and usages; ensure `using` targets exist and regenerate/fix references where needed.
Refine world map control architecture; keep server/client configs and environment values in JSON configs.
Validate protoc outputs are referenced correctly; solidify packet handling across client and server; run builds/selftest.
Update README and docs under `docs/` for protocol/worldgen/config changes; prepare commits and push.

client.name: world-map-preview-parity
client.description: World map preview generator uses hydrology-aware profile hash and protobuf handshake for chunk tiles.

client.name: protocol-client-bindings
client.description: Client protobuf DTO references stay aligned with SharedProtocol registry and descriptor fingerprint; guards against stale generated assemblies.

client.name: player-controller
client.description: Player movement, physics, block interaction, inventory management, and camera controls.

client.description: Main menu, HUD display, inventory interface, and settings menu.

client.name: network-client
client.description: Connection management, message handling, packet serialization/deserialization, and reconnection logic.

server.name: world-map-control-parity
server.description: Server-side world map control system with hash validation and chunk caching.

server.description: Protocol registry with validation for protobuf message handlers.

server.name: player-system
server.description: Player management system with health, hunger, experience, and abilities.

server.name: block-system
server.description: Block system with states, entities, and physics.

server.name: entity-system-foundation
server.description: Entity spawning, AI, and synchronization system.

server.name: network-session-management
server.description: Session lifecycle and room-based architecture.

client.name: map-visualization
client.description: Preview renderer consumes hydrology/flow/river/lake masks with seam-safe smoothing to display stitched terrain in editor/runtime.

client.name: block-rendering
client.description: Voxel mesh generation, block textures and materials, lighting calculations, and ambient occlusion.

client.name: entity-rendering
client.description: Player model rendering, mob model rendering, animation system, and entity effects.

client.name: particle-effects
client.description: Block break particles, weather particles, spell effects, and environmental effects.

client.name: sound-system
client.description: Block interaction sounds, ambient sounds, music system, and 3D spatial audio.

server.name: cave-river-lake-continuity
server.description: Hydrology-driven carving with edge continuity envelopes, seam-aware rivers/lakes, and ceiling sealing to keep subterranean water aligned with rivers and basins.

server.name: crafting-system
server.description: Recipe management, crafting interface, recipe book implementation, and special recipe unlocks.

server.name: structure-generation
server.description: Village generation, temple generation, dungeon generation, and mineshaft generation.

server.name: biome-system
server.description: Temperature/humidity gradients, vegetation distribution, ore distribution by biome, and biome-specific structures.

server.name: mob-spawning
server.description: Hostile mob spawning, passive mob spawning, spawn conditions and rates, and mob AI behaviors.

server.name: weather-system
server.description: Rain/snow effects, thunderstorms, weather transitions, and biome-specific weather.

client.name: streaming-profile-hotload
client.description: Hot-reloads map-control JSON and resets preview generator when hash or signature changes; keeps data-driven parameters synced during runtime.

client.name: asset-management
client.description: Asset loading and caching, asset bundles, memory management, and asset streaming.

client.name: settings-management
client.description: Graphics settings, audio settings, control bindings, and save/load settings.

client.name: performance-optimization
client.description: LOD system, occlusion culling, texture streaming, and frame rate limiting.

client.name: debug-tools
client.description: Debug overlay, profiling display, chunk inspector, and network debug view.

server.name: data-driven-config-refresh
server.description: JSON-backed config loader with checksum logging feeding world map control and hydrology/lake/cave thresholds; keep hashes in sync with map-control signatures.

server.name: database-management
server.description: SQLite integration, player data persistence, world data storage, and backup system.

server.name: logging-system
server.description: Structured logging, log levels and filtering, log rotation, and remote logging.

server.name: performance-monitoring
server.description: TPS monitoring, memory usage tracking, network statistics, and profiling tools.

server.name: command-system
server.description: Command framework, operator/permission system, built-in commands, and custom command support.
